description: List the Parfumo members the user follows (`action: "list"`, default), or follow / unfollow a member (`action: "follow"` / `"unfollow"` with `user`). Following is seen by the other member (it shows among their followers and may notify them). Following a member already followed, or unfollowing one not followed, sends nothing. Returns the follow state as Parfumo holds it after the call. On this server such writes stay in dry-run mode unless the operator enabled them, with a daily cap per user. Supports dry_run. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

dry_run.description: When true, nothing is sent: the answer shows the request that would be made.

user.description: Member to follow or unfollow: nickname or profile URL.

name: parfumo_manage_follow

url.description: Absolute Parfumo URL of the profile.

WriteCall.description:
A write request to Parfumo, as built before being sent (also shown by `dry_run`).
The session `csrf_key` is added at send time and never appears here.

form.description: Form fields (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), without the CSRF token.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was sent to Parfumo.

executed.description: True when a write request was sent.

following.description: Whether the account follows that member, as Parfumo states it after the call (before it in a dry run).

notes.description: Side effects and things to know.

planned_requests.description: The write request sent, or that would be sent.

public_writes_enabled.description: Whether this server is allowed to send publicly visible writes (operator setting).

total.description: With `list`: number of members followed, when the site states it.
